name: jev-excel
description: Excel add-in that lets you call TypeSafe AI's Jev model from formulas: =JEV.ASK("choice", A2, "option1", "option2").
author: Paul O'Brien

scripts.start: office-addin-debugging start manifest.xml desktop --dev-server "npm run serve" --dev-server-port 3000
scripts.start:web: office-addin-debugging start manifest.xml web --dev-server "npm run serve" --dev-server-port 3000
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler@4 deploy
